steps.summary: Signed in and created ticket 'fwrd39-n3 RD Bench Ticket'. The earlier replay's steps 1-4 (click New ticket, fill Title, fill Customer, click Create ticket) already created it — it shows in the list as **RD-1017**, title "fwrd39-n3 RD Bench Ticket", customer "Bench Test Co", status "Draft", created 2026-09-01. Required fields in the form: **Title** (marked with * — required), **Customer** (optional). No confirmation toast/notification appeared after submission; the ticket simply appeared in the list. Screenshot taken of the list showing it.

Opened ticket RD-1017 / "fwrd39-n3 RD Bench Ticket". Added part "fwrd39-n3 RD Part A" with Cost=$100, Markup=25% and default Quantity=1 (no supplier). The dialog showed required fields: Part name*, Cost*, and Markup %*. After submitting, the dialog closed and the detail view refreshed with the new row. The app computed Price = **$125.00** ($100 cost + 25% markup).

Added second part "fwrd39-n3 RD Part B" with Cost=$200 and Markup=25% (Quantity=1, No supplier). After submission the detail view refreshed with both parts listed: Part A ($100.00 cost, 25% markup, $125.00 price) and Part B ($200.00 cost, 25% markup, $250.00 price). The total shown is $375.00 ($125 + $250). The app computes Part B's price as **$250.00**.

Edited part "fwrd39-n3 RD Part A" in ticket RD-1017: changed Cost from $100 to $150 while keeping Markup at 25%. The detail view refreshed immediately. Part A now shows Cost=$150.00, Markup=25%, Price=$187.50 (was $125.00). The new parts total is **$437.50** (Part A $187.50 + Part B $250.00).

Clicked "Mark Ready" on ticket RD-1017. The app showed an alert: "Ticket is not ready - Part 'fwrd39-n3 RD Part A' has no supplier - Part 'fwrd39-n3 RD Part B' has no supplier". The precondition was: **every part must have a Supplier assigned**. I edited each part (Part A and Part B) and set their Supplier field to "Bench Supplier Co". After saving both, I clicked "Mark Ready" again and the status changed from "Draft" to "Ready". The buttons changed to "Mark Draft" and "Mark Closed", confirming the new status. The final status is **Ready**.

Deleted both parts and archived the ticket. For each part, clicked the delete button which triggered a custom "Confirm" dialog with "Cancel" and "Delete part" buttons — accepted the confirmation by clicking "Delete part". Part A and Part B both disappeared from the parts table (showing "No parts on this ticket yet"). Then clicked "Archive ticket" (no dialog appeared; the button changed to "Unarchive ticket"). Went to the tickets list — RD-1017 is absent from the active list. Clicked "Show archived" and found it listed: title "fwrd39-n3 RD Bench Ticket Archived", status Ready, Parts 0. Everything is cleaned up.
